name: cursor-ai-cost-optimizer
description: Cuts your Cursor AI bill: routes each request to the cheapest model tier that can do it well, with quality guardrails. Sets up in Cursor's user-level config (nothing written into projects) or per project.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Writes .cursor/ files and installs hooks that execute a binary.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Needs a local .cursor/ folder and a local hook runtime.

enumDescriptions: Use the bundled cco-hook binary when this build ships one for your platform, otherwise Node.js.
Always use the bundled binary (fails if this build has none for your platform).
Always run hooks with `node .cursor/cco-hook.mjs` (Node.js >= 18 must be on the PATH Cursor sees). Keeps .cursor/hooks.json portable for teammates.
costOptimizer.hookRuntime.markdownDescription: How the hook entries are executed. `auto` uses Node.js >= 18 when available and falls back to the bundled `cco-hook` binary. Changing this takes effect on the next **Turn On / Update Models** or activation-time repair pass.

costOptimizer.nodePath.markdownDescription: Absolute path of the Node.js executable used to run the plugin's setup scripts (`cco-init`, discovery). Default: `node` on PATH, then Cursor's own Node runtime. Ignored when `#costOptimizer.hookRuntime#` is `binary`.

costOptimizer.autoEnable.markdownDescription: Turn the Cost Optimizer on automatically after it is installed (once per machine; **Remove from Cursor** in the status menu turns it off). Off: nothing happens until you run **AI Cost Optimizer: Turn On / Update Models**.

costOptimizer.tierModels.fast.markdownDescription: Model id that runs the **Fast** tier (quick answers, small edits), e.g. `composer-2.5`. Empty = the cheapest sufficient model on your account. The status menu's **Choose tier models** lists what your account can use.

costOptimizer.tierModels.balanced.markdownDescription: Model id that runs the **Balanced** tier (typical implementation work), e.g. `claude-sonnet-5-thinking-high`. Empty = automatic.

costOptimizer.tierModels.deep.markdownDescription: Model id that runs the **Deep** tier (risky or complex work), e.g. `claude-opus-5-thinking-high`. Empty = automatic.

costOptimizer.enforceRouting.markdownDescription: Enforce cost routing instead of advising it. Off (default): the chat model is advised to delegate routine work and only your `[cco:…]` overrides and risk escalations are enforced. On: a chat model that is materially pricier than the tier's model may not edit or run commands itself; it must delegate.

costOptimizer.alwaysDelegate.markdownDescription: Route every request that needs tools through a tier subagent, even when the tier's model is not cheaper than your chat model (useful to keep costs logged per tier).

costOptimizer.chatBudgetUsd.markdownDescription: Estimated spend per chat, in USD, after which you are warned (at 80%) and routing is forced to the Fast tier beyond twice the budget. `0` = no budget.

costOptimizer.modelCooldownHours.markdownDescription: How long a model that refused to start a subagent (usage limit) is skipped before it is tried again. Tasks step down a tier meanwhile.

costOptimizer.showSavingsInStatusBar.markdownDescription: Show the estimated savings for the current project in the status bar (`⚡ Saved ~$4.12`). Off: the item reads `AI Cost`.

costOptimizer.showRoutingNotifications.markdownDescription: When a task goes to a tier subagent, show a short notification naming the model that is doing it (`Composer 2.5 (Fast tier) is doing this task`). The chat's own model picker keeps showing the chat model, so this is where you see what actually ran; the status bar names it too.

enumDescriptions: Safe commands (tests, builds, reads) run; the rest are declined and shown as not run.
Every command the model issues runs (the Cursor CLI's --force).
costOptimizer.chat.runCommands.markdownDescription: Which shell commands the cost-routed chat may run. It runs through the Cursor CLI (`cursor-agent`) on your Cursor account.

costOptimizer.chat.cliPath.markdownDescription: Full path to the Cursor CLI (`cursor-agent`) when it is not on the PATH the extension host sees. Empty: PATH, then `~/.local/bin/cursor-agent` and the installer's versions directory are tried.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with AI Cost Optimizer
walkthroughs.description: It is already on. Here is what you will see, and how to steer it.

steps.title: It is on. These are your tiers
steps.description: Fast, Balanced and Deep each run on a model from your account; the table shows the mapping as of opening this page (hover **AI Cost** in the status bar for the current one). To change it: [Choose tier models](command:cco.chooseTierModels), or [Settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22cost%20optimizer%22%5D).

To change it: [Choose tier models](command:cco.chooseTierModels), or [Settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22cost%20optimizer%22%5D).

steps.title: Work as usual
steps.description: Keep your chat model. On an Opus-class chat model, routine work runs on a cheaper model through a subagent named after that model and its tier (a **Composer 2.5 Fast** card, for example; click it to see its steps and diffs); on Auto, Composer, Grok, Sonnet and GPT it stays in the chat, because on Cursor's bill a delegation costs about what the work does. The status bar names where each task ran. Risky work goes to the Deep tier. Nothing is blocked for long, nothing is written into your project.

steps.title: Steer when you want to
steps.description: Say it in the prompt ("use the best model", "don't route this") or use `[cco:deep]` / `[cco:fast]`. Pause a project, set a per-chat budget, or enforce routing from the status menu or [Settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22cost%20optimizer%22%5D).
